Session view loads with tool call blocks clickable. Tool detail view (click-to-expand) works correctly for Bash tools. Input toolbar confirmed missing file attachment button. Service messages, AskUserQuestion buttons, and markdown text all render. No console errors observed.

feature_inventory.notes: Connects to api.life-ai.app via MMKV server URL override, shows 'connected' status
Lists sessions under machine card but session names both show 'root' instead of titles set via change_title

feature_inventory.feature: Session view with tool call blocks
feature_inventory.notes: Tool calls render as clickable blocks with icon, title, command. Click navigates to detail view.
Full output displayed in dark code block, back navigation works. Confirmed for Bash tools.
Multiple choice buttons render and are tappable
Service messages render as gray text. However the title-change service message text shows correctly in chat but the session header does NOT update to the new title (Bug #62 confirmed still broken).
useAttachments.ts hook and AttachmentStrip.tsx exist in codebase but are never imported or used in SessionView.tsx or AgentInput.tsx. No attachment button in toolbar.
No download functionality exists anywhere in the app. No way to download files Claude produces.
MermaidRenderer.tsx exists and is integrated in MarkdownView.tsx. Web platform uses dynamic import. However Bug #61 (timeline with Chinese chars) unfixed.
LatexRenderer.tsx exists, parseMarkdown.ts defines 'latex' block type, but MarkdownView.tsx has NO case for block.type === 'latex'. Falls through to null render. LaTeX content is silently dropped.
AgentEventBlock in MessageView.tsx handles 'switch', 'message', 'limit-reached' but has NO case for 'wrapped' type. Wrap envelopes show as generic 'Unknown event' gray text.
typesRaw.ts explicitly returns null for start/stop envelopes - they are intentionally not rendered. This is by design.

TaskView renders inside ToolView which already renders outer header. TaskView then renders its own summary header again - title duplication. Inner tool calls in ChildMessageBlock are rendered without messageId so they are not clickable.
All sections render: machine info, Account, Appearance, Voice Assistant, Features, Usage, What's New
Empty state renders correctly with 'Empty Inbox' message

MarkdownView.tsx line 308: showsHorizontalScrollIndicator is set to Platform.OS !== 'web', which means it is explicitly FALSE on Web platform. Tables and code blocks lose their horizontal scroll indicator on web.

change_title tool correctly calls summary message via apiSession.ts. Server receives and updates metadata.summary. App reads metadata.summary in getSessionName(). Session header renders correctly (shows title in chat). BUT sidebar session list still shows 'root' instead of the updated title - the session list does not re-render when summary updates.

issues.title: File upload feature missing from input toolbar
issues.description: The attachment/upload button is completely absent from the input toolbar. useAttachments.ts hook and AttachmentStrip.tsx are implemented in the codebase but never imported or called anywhere in SessionView.tsx or AgentInput.tsx. The sync layer supports attachments (sync.sendMessage accepts attachments param) and the server upload route exists at POST /v3/sessions/:id/upload. The UI integration was lost during the merge with origin.
issues.details: useAttachments hook at sources/hooks/useAttachments.ts:83 is fully implemented with pickImage, pickDocument, addFileFromPaste, clearAttachments. AttachmentStrip component at sources/components/AttachmentStrip.tsx is implemented. Neither is imported in SessionView or AgentInput. The AgentInput component also has no onAttachPress prop defined.
issues.observation_notes: Confirmed in browser: toolbar shows gear, info, git-diff badge, send button only. No paperclip icon. Screenshot: po-05-session2-toolbar.png

issues.title: LaTeX rendering silently broken - content not rendered
issues.description: LaTeX content in Claude responses is silently dropped and not displayed. parseMarkdown.ts defines a 'latex' block type and parseMarkdownBlock extracts latex blocks from text, but MarkdownView.tsx has no handler for block.type === 'latex'. The block falls through to the final else clause and returns null. LatexRenderer.tsx is a fully implemented component that is never imported in MarkdownView.
issues.details: MarkdownView renderContent() iterates over blocks and handles: text, header, horizontal-rule, list, numbered-list, code-block, mermaid, options, table, image. There is no 'latex' case. The 'latex' block type is defined in parseMarkdown.ts:24. LatexRenderer.tsx at components/markdown/LatexRenderer.tsx is a complete implementation using katex. It just needs to be imported and rendered with: else if (block.type === 'latex') { return <LatexRenderer content={block.content} key={index} />; }
issues.observation_notes: Code review finding confirmed by cross-referencing MarkdownView.tsx (no latex case), parseMarkdown.ts (defines latex type), LatexRenderer.tsx (exists but unused). Feature #1 in bug-fixes.md claims LaTeX was implemented but the MarkdownView wiring is missing.

issues.title: Wrap envelope renders as 'Unknown event' instead of collapsible prompt
issues.description: The 'wrap' envelope type (used for skill/command prompt collapsible blocks) is not properly handled in the UI. typesRaw.ts normalizes wrap envelopes to AgentEvent with type='wrapped', but AgentEventBlock in MessageView.tsx only handles 'switch', 'message', and 'limit-reached'. Wrap envelopes fall through to the final return block showing 'Unknown event' as gray text.
issues.details: AgentEventBlock handles: type==='switch', type==='message', type==='limit-reached'. No case for type==='wrapped'. The 'wrapped' event has label and content fields. It should render as a collapsible block showing the label as header and content as body. This is the 'wrap' envelope type defined in sessionProtocol.ts for skill/command prompts.
issues.observation_notes: Code review: typesRaw.ts:584 maps wrap envelope to {type: 'wrapped', label, content}. MessageView.tsx:108-149 AgentEventBlock has no case for 'wrapped'.

issues.title: File download support entirely absent
issues.description: There is no way for users to download files that Claude produces during sessions. No download button, no save-to-device functionality, no export feature exists anywhere in the app. This is a significant gap compared to Claude Desktop, ChatGPT, and Gemini which all support downloading generated files.
issues.details: Users can view file content in tool call detail views (Read tool output, Write tool output in code blocks) but cannot save them. Code blocks have a copy button but no download button. No route or API exists for file download. The server has upload routes (POST /v3/sessions/:id/upload) but no corresponding download routes for session-generated files.
issues.observation_notes: Browser confirmed no download buttons exist in tool detail views or message content areas. Code search found no download functionality.

issues.title: Bug #64: TaskView title duplication - outer ToolView header + inner TaskSummary both show
issues.description: When Task or Agent tool calls render, the outer ToolView renders a header with the tool name ('Task' or 'Agent'), then inside the content area TaskView renders its own TaskSummary which shows the sub-tool names. This creates two stacked headers for the same tool call block.
issues.details: ToolView always renders the header section (lines 161-205) with toolTitle. Then renders SpecificToolView in content area (line 218). For Task/Agent tools, TaskView is the SpecificToolView. TaskView renders TaskSummary which is another visual header showing tool names. The result is: outer header 'Task [icon]' + inner summary '[sub-tool names] [chevron]'. Bug #64 documented in bug-fixes.md as unfixed.
issues.observation_notes: Code review finding. Bug is documented in /root/docs/BUG-FIXES.md as Bug #64 - unfixed.

issues.title: Bug #64: Tool calls inside expanded TaskView are not clickable
issues.description: When a Task/Agent block is expanded, ChildMessageBlock renders tool call children using ToolView without passing messageId. Since ToolView.isPressable requires messageId (or onPress), the tool call headers in the expanded task view are not clickable and cannot navigate to their detail views.
issues.details: ChildMessageBlock renders: <ToolView tool={message.tool} metadata={metadata} messages={message.children} sessionId={sessionId} messageId={message.id} />. The messageId IS passed (message.id) so this specific regression may be FIXED in the current code. However the outer ToolView still renders even when TaskView should be self-contained.
issues.observation_notes: Code review: ChildMessageBlock at TaskView.tsx:177 passes messageId={message.id}. This regression from Bug #64 may actually be resolved in current code. Needs live testing with a Task tool call to verify.

issues.title: Bug #62: Session sidebar title not updating after change_title MCP call
issues.description: When Claude calls mcp__happy__change_title, the service message shows correctly in the chat ('Title changed to X') but the session name in the sidebar continues to show 'root' (the working directory name). The session header in the chat view also shows 'root'. The summary metadata updates on the server but does not propagate to trigger a sidebar re-render.
issues.details: getSessionName() at sessionUtils.ts:80 checks session.metadata?.summary first. The change_title MCP path: Claude calls mcp__happy__change_title -> startHappyServer handler sends {type:'summary', summary:title} -> apiSession.ts updateMetadata is called -> server updates metadata. If metadata update reaches the app correctly, getSessionName would return the new title. But browser confirms both sessions show 'root'. Bug #62 documented in bug-fixes.md as unfixed.
issues.observation_notes: Browser confirmed: session with service message 'Title changed to "Test: new session creation"' shows 'root' in both header and sidebar. Screenshot: po-01-landing-session.png, po-05-session2-toolbar.png

issues.title: Bug #63: Table/code block horizontal scroll indicator hidden on web
issues.description: Tables and code blocks in the chat use ScrollView with showsHorizontalScrollIndicator set to Platform.OS !== 'web'. This explicitly hides the scroll indicator on the web platform. Users on web cannot tell whether a table or code block is horizontally scrollable.
issues.details: Line 187 (code blocks): showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false} - always hidden. Line 308 (tables): showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={Platform.OS !== 'web'} - explicitly false on web. The correct behavior for web should be true or use CSS overflow-x styling. Bug #63 documented in bug-fixes.md as unfixed.
issues.observation_notes: Code review confirmed. Behavior visible on web viewport in desktop mode.

issues.title: Bug #61: Mermaid timeline diagrams with Chinese characters fail to render
issues.description: Mermaid timeline diagrams containing Chinese characters or empty events fail to render. The MermaidRenderer falls back to showing the raw diagram source with a 'Mermaid diagram syntax error' message. Bug-fixes.md documents this as 'fix failed - sanitizeMermaidContent approach did not work'.
issues.details: MermaidRenderer uses mermaid.render() and catches errors, showing fallback with raw content. The sanitize approach was attempted but failed. No sanitization code is present in current MermaidRenderer.tsx - the previous fix was reverted or never merged. The mermaid library itself has known issues with non-ASCII characters in timeline diagrams.
issues.observation_notes: Bug documented in /root/docs/BUG-FIXES.md as Bug #61 with status 'fix failed'. Code review shows no sanitization logic in current MermaidRenderer.tsx.

issues.title: Session titles in sidebar both show 'root' instead of actual session names
issues.description: Both active sessions in the sidebar display 'root' as their name. The expected behavior is to show the session title set via change_title MCP, or at minimum the full path. 'root' is just the last segment of the working directory path '/', which is an uninformative default.
issues.details: getSessionName() at sessionUtils.ts:84-89 extracts the last segment of metadata.path when no summary is set. For sessions running in '/' (root), the last path segment is empty, falling through to t('status.unknown') or returning 'root'. The summary update from change_title is not being applied. Related to Bug #62.
issues.observation_notes: Browser confirmed: sidebar shows 'root' for both sessions. One session has a service message confirming title was changed to 'Test: new session creation'. Screenshot: po-01-landing-session.png

summary: 10 issues found across all priority tiers. Most critical: (1) File upload feature is fully implemented in code (useAttachments.ts, AttachmentStrip.tsx, server routes) but the UI wiring was lost during merge with origin - neither component is imported in SessionView or AgentInput. (2) LaTeX rendering is silently broken - LatexRenderer.tsx exists and is fully implemented but MarkdownView.tsx has no case for 'latex' block type, causing all LaTeX content to be dropped. (3) Wrap envelope type renders as 'Unknown event' instead of collapsible skill/command prompt. (4) File download support is entirely absent from the app with no planned implementation visible. Mermaid rendering works for standard diagrams but Bug #61 (Chinese timeline) remains unfixed. TaskView has title duplication issue (Bug #64). Session title change via MCP shows in chat but does not update sidebar (Bug #62). Table horizontal scroll indicator is explicitly disabled on web (Bug #63).
clean_areas: Bash tool call click-to-expand detail view: works correctly with title, command, output, back navigation (verified: po-04-tool-detail.png)
AskUserQuestion buttons: render and are tappable with correct styling
Settings page: all sections render correctly including machine info, account, appearance, voice, features, usage, changelog
Inbox empty state: renders with correct icon and message
Authentication flow: localStorage injection works reliably, connects to correct API server
Service messages: render correctly as gray text in chat
Mobile layout: bottom tab bar, session view render correctly at 375px
MermaidRenderer: component structure is correct for standard diagrams (dark/light theme, error fallback, loading state)
LatexRenderer: component itself is correctly implemented - the bug is in MarkdownView not calling it
